title: Medicaid and CHIP Renewal Continuity Navigator
tagline: The safest renewal form is the one a family never has to complete when the agency already has reliable proof.

cards: The obvious workflow asks every household to complete it.
The agency may already hold proof
Ex parte review can remove burden without weakening the decision.
Duplicate paperwork can cause avoidable coverage loss.
The household stays protected while the agency owns eligibility.

story.headline: The renewal form the family should never receive
beats: A family approaches its annual Medicaid renewal.
Reliable agency data already contains every deciding fact.
The agent copies a prior workflow and requests the entire application again.
The burden gate reuses evidence, preserves rights, and routes only an agency-owned decision.
